Subject: Acme Health POC: workload profile & next steps

Hi Laura —

Great to chat today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned for the PoC/trial: 

Summary of requirements you shared:
- Primary use case: chart summarization + clinical note retrieval for provider workflow
- Target latency: 95th pct <= 400ms for single-request summaries
- Expected traffic during evaluation: steady-state ~8 RPS, peak bursts up to 120 RPS for 30-45s, typical concurrency 12-16 workers
- Typical input token lengths: median~350 tokens, 95th~1,200 tokens for long visit notes
- Output lengths: median~120 tokens, typical max ~400 tokens

Immediate asks / action items:
1) Can you share a sample workload profile CSV (RPS by hour, sample token length distribution) and a small set of anonymized example records we can use for benchmarking?
2) Please confirm your success criteria for the trial (quality metrics + traffic targets) — we'll propose pass/fail thresholds in the PoC plan.
3) Ownership: I’ll be PoC owner from Redwood (Ben). Marissa will lead implementation and infra. Who will be our primary contact on the Acme side?
4) Timeline: propose a 4-week evaluation once we have the workload snapshot. Week 0: setup & seed data; Weeks 1-3: run evaluation and iterate; Week 4: final review.

I attached a small workload template CSV you can fill that maps to the fields we need (RPS, avg tokens, p95 tokens, concurrency).

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes kickoff + infra checklist — Thu 2027-06-10 10:00am PT or Fri 2027-06-11 9:00am PT. Which works best?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Attaching a short snapshot from our telemetry and a small sample set (anonymized) for your benchmarking. High level notes below: 

Workload snapshot (attached: acme_workload_snapshot.csv):
- Steady-state: 7-9 RPS during business hours (8am-6pm PT)
- Daily peak: up to 95-120 RPS for 20–60s bursts (triggered by batch imports and morning syncs)
- Concurrency: normal 10–18 service threads; can spike to ~60 for brief windows
- Token distribution (input): mean 380, median 350, p95 1,150, max ~1,800 (rare)
- Token distribution (output): mean 140, p95 380

Success criteria (internal):
- Functional: >= 85% of clinical summaries rated >=4/5 by our internal review (sample of 500 docs)
- Performance: 95th latency <= 450ms for single-request summary under steady-state load; tail behavior acceptable during burst with graceful degradation
- Cost: within projected budget (we'll share target $/1k tokens once procurement confirms)

Owners on our side: Laura Chen (PM, PoC lead), Mark Ortega (SRE), Priya Natarajan (Security contact).

We can do the Thu 10:00am PT kickoff — that works for the core team.

Laura

--

Looping in implementation leads and drafting a PoC plan based on Laura's snapshot. Key items I'm proposing (first draft):

POC Plan (RDW_POC_Plan_v1.pdf attached) — highlights:
- Environment: dedicated trial cluster (non-prod) with same model variant as prod candidate (quantized + KV cache enabled)
- Ingest: use provided anonymized sample + replay of 30 minutes of production-like burst events to measure tail behavior
- Metrics to capture: latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens served, cost estimate, quality via blind eval (500 samples), error rate, model fallback events
- Success thresholds (proposal): quality >= 85% pass rate; p95 latency <= 450ms steady-state; system sustains 75% of observed peak for 60s with graceful degradation
- Rollout: if PoC passes, 2-week pilot with expanded dataset before production cutover

Timeline: 
- Fri 2027-06-11: kickoff + infra checklist (30 min)
- Week of 2027-06-14: cluster provisioning + baseline runs
- Week of 2027-06-21: focused evaluation, iterate config (batching, cache, quantization)
- Week of 2027-06-28: final report and recommendations

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: draft PoC runbook & monitoring playbook
- Dylan: provision trial cluster and prepare replay harness (need sample event window with timestamps)
- Ben: confirm procurement timeline and license agreement touchpoints

Action items for Acme:
- Laura: send 30-minute production replay window (anonymized) + security questionnaire answers to Priya (cc'd to Priya if possible)
- Mark: confirm SRE contact for network and egress checks

Please review and flag anything missing — attaching the PoC plan and a monitoring checklist.

Thanks — Marissa
